findings.claim: The tagging step rests on a wrong premise: "copier renders the newest tag (v0.1.1 today)". JasperHG90/kmctl-starter already has v0.2.0 (212e4d5, "Add just upgrade") and v0.2.1 (0dbec4c, origin/main HEAD) on the remote, each with a GitHub release; v0.2.1 is Latest. The local clone only has v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 fetched, which is why it looks like v0.1.1. Copier picks the highest PEP 440 tag, so a new v0.1.2 sorts below v0.2.1 and `uvx copier copy gh:JasperHG90/kmctl-starter` keeps rendering v0.2.1, which has no OpenCode choice. The done-when item "offers OpenCode (tag v0.1.2)" cannot be met as written. Fix: fetch tags first, then tag above v0.2.1 (v0.3.0 fits a new harness choice; v0.2.2 also works), and name that tag in the plan.
The plan now tags v0.3.0. That sorts above v0.2.1, the highest tag on the starter, so copier renders it.
